title: Hpa-An vs Inle Lake: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Hpa-An for adventurous travelers seeking karst scenery and scooter freedom without crowds. Inle Lake for first-time Myanmar visitors wanting iconic floating villages and cultural depth.

categories.name: Natural Scenery
categories.summary: Hpa-An's limestone karst towers and cave systems are more dramatic. Inle Lake's floating villages are uniquely iconic.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Hpa-An is 40-50% cheaper — $20-40/day vs Inle Lake's $40-80/day.

categories.name: Crowds
categories.summary: Hpa-An is genuinely uncrowded. Inle Lake is Myanmar's most visited inland destination.

categories.name: Cultural Depth
categories.summary: Inle Lake's Intha floating villages and Indein ruins offer deeper cultural immersion.

categories.name: Photography
categories.summary: Leg-rowing fishermen at sunrise are world-class photography subjects.

categories.name: Getting There
categories.summary: Bus from Yangon 7-8h ($8-15). Inle Lake requires a flight ($50-100) or very long bus.

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: Scooter freedom in Hpa-An vs mandatory boat hire at Inle Lake.

categories.name: Accommodation
categories.summary: Inle Lake has luxury stilted lake lodges. Hpa-An has basic but excellent guesthouses.

categories.name: Food
categories.summary: Inle Lake has better variety including Shan noodles and the rotating market.

categories.name: Infrastructure
categories.summary: More developed for Myanmar — better transport links, wider accommodation range.

faq.question: Is Hpa-An or Inle Lake better for first-time Myanmar visitors?
faq.answer: Inle Lake is the classic first-timer choice with more established infrastructure. Hpa-An rewards repeat visitors or those specifically seeking karst scenery without crowds.

faq.question: How much does it cost per day in Hpa-An vs Inle Lake?
faq.answer: Hpa-An: $20-40/day mid-range. Inle Lake: $40-80/day including mandatory boat hire of $15-25/day.

faq.question: Can you visit both Hpa-An and Inle Lake on one Myanmar trip?
faq.answer: Yes, but there's no direct transport. Plan 7-10 days minimum, routing via Yangon between destinations.
